sections.title: ENTITY MATCHING TASK
sections.description: You are an expert at entity matching. Your task is to find the candidate that refers to the same real-world entity as the left record.
unordered_list: Two records match if they refer to the EXACT SAME product/entity, not just similar ones
Different model numbers, part numbers, or SKUs usually indicate different products
Products from the same brand/category but with different specifications are NOT matches
Records match even with different formatting, spellings, or missing information

sections.title: COMPARISON CRITERIA
sections.description: Compare the left record against each candidate. Look for:
ordered_list: EXACT model numbers, part numbers, or product codes (most important)
Identical product names (allowing for abbreviations and formatting)
Matching specifications and features where provided
Same brand AND same specific product line/model
No contradictory model numbers or specifications

sections.title: CRITICAL DISTINCTIONS
unordered_list: Same product (different retailers) vs Different models from same brand
Exact model match vs Similar/related products
Missing information vs Contradictory information
Abbreviations/formatting differences vs Actual content differences

sections.title: REASONING PROCESS
sections.description: Think step by step: 1) Compare model/part numbers first, 2) Check product names, 3) Verify no contradictory specs, 4) Decide if EXACT same entity.

sections.title: RESPONSE FORMAT REQUIREMENTS
sections.description: Your response must follow this exact format:
unordered_list: You MUST respond with ONLY a single integer number
If the candidate matches the left record: respond with the candidate number
If NO candidate matches the left record: respond with "-1"
DO NOT include any words, explanations, or other text
DO NOT include quotes, brackets, or punctuation
Examples of CORRECT responses: `7` or `-1`
Examples of INCORRECT responses: "no match", "the movie babel", "candidate 0"
